paper_title: Piezoelectrically Tuned Multimode Cavity Search for Axion Dark Matter
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (approximate, read from Fig. 4 axis ranges)
notes: ADMX Sidecar haloscope excludes axion-photon coupling in three frequency ranges: A (4202-4249 MHz, TM010, 17.38-17.57 ueV), B (5086-5799 MHz, TM010, 21.03-23.98 ueV), C (7173-7203 MHz, TM020, 29.67-29.79 ueV). The exclusion plots (Fig 4) span g_agamma roughly 1e-13 to 1e-10 GeV^-1; precise numerical values are not tabulated, so data points are approximate representative values read from the plot axes (regions A/B reach ~1e-12, region C weaker due to lower form factor).
